# NuIQ

> NuIQ is an AI therapy notes tool for mental health professionals. It writes SOAP, DAP and progress notes from live in-person sessions, telehealth sessions, uploaded recordings, dictated summaries or typed details, for individual, family and group sessions. Notes are copied into any EHR. NuIQ is made by NuIQ LLC, Pleasant Grove, Utah.

- Pricing: free 2-week trial (no credit card), Professional at $49 per user per month, and custom Enterprise pricing for centers with 2+ users.
- EHR integration partners: Alleva, Kipu and AdvancedMD. Notes can be pasted into any EHR.
- Contact: sales@nuiq.com (sales), support@nuiq.com (support), 801-462-5000.
